protocol.baseline_B_recipe: read_aiger original; strash; rewrite; write_aiger candidate; reload candidate with the common Evaluator
protocol.measurement: cec -n original candidate; read_lib ASAP7; read_aiger candidate; map; topo; stime -p; write_verilog mapped.v; ABC_SCL_LIBERTY from same SC_Man for global and every PO

abc_build_provenance.features: CUDD and pthreads; no readline; endpoint/path observers from build source snapshot
abc_build_provenance.scope: Reuse the verified binary and original build evidence; no rebuild or ABC upgrade.

protocol.precision: float64 proxy/STE/logits; frozen float32 CPU Student
protocol.algorithm: no-op-biased logits (+2, noise sigma .01), masked softmax, sparse legal hard projection, STE, Adam. 40 steps/1 restart, temperature 1 to .3, gradient clip5. Best visited proxy objective including original.
protocol.runtime_scope: Cold process start/exit + input staging + all preparation/optimization + own original and optional one final evaluation + persistence. Queue, one-time build and reporting excluded.
protocol.mapping_budget: One original mapping plus at most one nonempty final candidate; no replay-noop, no calibration, no retry or repair.
protocol.projection: GPU top candidate margin over no-op per Decision; stable descending sort; at most128 positive rows to CPU CandidateFeasibility, at most16 edits; sparse hard tensor built on device.
protocol.selection: Only complete replay ACCEPTED + CEC PASS; final area <=1.05 original and strictly lower actual delay; otherwise own paid original.
